name: codeflow
description: Turn telemetry and an opt-in context reduction experiment for Claude Code

maxFileLines.title: Lines per read
maxFileLines.description: Maximum lines of a read file that enter the context (the rest becomes a summary with entry points)

maxToolResultChars.title: Characters per read or search result
maxToolResultChars.description: Maximum characters of a tool result (search, test, CSV) that reaches the model

maxListItems.title: Items per search result
maxListItems.description: Maximum items of a list (files, matches) kept before summarizing

guardPatterns.title: Additional patterns to flag
guardPatterns.description: Comma-separated literal patterns. Active mode flags eligible calls with ask, preserving the native decision.

turnSummary.title: Summary per response
turnSummary.description: Shows duration, requests, tools, tokens and context under each response.

thinking.title: Count reasoning blocks
thinking.description: Counts blocks and words when exposed by Claude, without copying text.

sessionLog.title: Save summary on exit
sessionLog.description: Writes a numeric session summary to .codeflow in the project.
